scientific_integrity: Exhaustive exact rational finite proof, independent direct subset checks for the witness, and literature comparisons; residual risk from unindexed prior enumerations. Self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification covers exactly two species and 2..15 sites, uniform without-replacement site sampling with fixed known incidences and perfect detection; it does not quantify empirical signal detectability or larger-site behavior. No claim of newness is made for the hypergeometric expectation formula or normalized monotonicity.
title: The first double peak of sample-incidence singletons occurs at fifteen sites
